title: codebase-meta
description: Metadata carried by every script in a lab project. Build plan §5.2. Ships as package data inside labdocs so the schema and the parser version together.

exempt.description: Why this file is not a pipeline step. A bare 'true' is not an answer.

name.description: Single lowercase underscore string, matching the filename stem (ADR-11).

order.description: Run order. Also names the output directory: outputs/<order>_<name>/.

entrypoint.description: True if a human runs this directly. Answers 'which of these do I actually type?' — prior_art.md §2.

draft.description: Written by `labdocs adopt`, not yet reviewed. Warning at conformance level 2, error at level 3 (build plan §9.3).

container.description: Image reference. Digest-pinned (@sha256:) for anything archived with a manuscript; a docker.io/ reference is dev-only (D-004).

from.description: Name of the producing script. Mutually exclusive with external.

external.description: True for inputs originating outside the DAG. Silence is not a valid answer — an input needs one of from/external.

pipe.description: A stream rather than a file. Exempt from the out_ naming rule — there is no file to name.

to.description: Consuming script for a piped output. An unconsumed stream is a bug.

desc.description: Undescribed outputs are how data dictionaries die.

next.description: Downstream script names, or the literal 'final' for a terminal step.
